description: Find open remote jobs on RemoteHunt for a job title or profession. With the country the person lives in, only jobs whose postings say they can hire there are returned. Returns up to 10 jobs with title, company, posting age, stated pay, where each job can hire, and a link to its RemoteHunt page.

country.description: Country the person lives in: a name or an ISO code, e.g. "Brazil" or "BR".
country.title: Country

level.description: Optional level: junior, mid, senior or lead.
level.title: Level

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 1 to 10.
limit.title: Limit

role.description: Job title or profession, e.g. "product designer" or "data analyst".
role.title: Role

name: search_remote_jobs
title: Search remote jobs
